meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 给已有的说话头/访谈/播客视频叠加定时图形卡片(动态标题、下三分、数据等),卡片内容和视频里正在说的话对应;每张卡片的HTML在对话里直接写,最后用hyperframes生成MP4视频。原视频保持不变。
howto.when: 当用户提到「图形叠加」「屏幕图形」「打包/装饰我的视频」,要求给现有说话头/访谈/播客视频加图形包装时触发;纯字幕需求不适用,意图不明时交由 /hyperframes 处理。

say.text: 给我的访谈视频加上下三分和标题卡片。
say.note: 技能会转写视频并据此规划卡片时间点。

say.text: 把这段播客视频打包,加数据引用和侧面板。
say.note: 技能会生成故事板并渲染MP4。

say.text: 给这个talking-head视频做16:9的图形包装。
say.note: 可指定9:16或4:5等其他画布比例。

howto.what_en: Layers timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, etc.) over an existing talking-head video, synced to the transcript; HTML for each card is written in chat, then rendered to MP4 via hyperframes. Source clip untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests graphic overlays, on-screen graphics, or 'packaging' of a talking-head/interview/podcast video. Plain subtitles not included; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add lower-thirds and title cards to my interview video.
say_en.note: It transcribes the video and plans card timings.

say_en.text: Package this podcast segment with data callouts and side panels.
say_en.note: It drafts a storyboard and renders an MP4.

say_en.text: Dress up this talking-head video with graphics on a 16:9 canvas.
say_en.note: Other canvas sizes like 9:16 or 4:5 are available.
